description: Draft tickets extracted from one meeting summary.

issues.description: The distinct action items agreed in the meeting, one ticket each. Empty when the meeting has no action items.

title.description: A crisp, concise title for the task, in plain text.

summary.description: One to three plain sentences stating what the task is and why it is needed, written as a single line with no line breaks. Start it with a word, not with a space or `#`. Duplicate detection compares tickets by this field.

body.description: The markdown body of the draft ticket, made up of the sections listed in these instructions. It must start with the `## Problem Statement` heading, with nothing before it.
